scheme: periodic finite-volume Rusanov, forward Euler, positive wet depths; SciPy correlate1d flux divergence
analytic: linear right-going sinusoid and exact wet-bed Riemann rarefaction/shock; g=9.81 m/s^2
inputs: Each npz stores initial state, dx, dt, steps, depth; float32-quantized inputs, float64 references. Dam at x=0; linear domain [0,1000), dam domain [-100,100).

tolerances.parity: 1e-4 max error normalized by max reference magnitude per component, with scale floor 1e-30; float32 rounding
tolerances.gradient: 1e-3 normalized max error, float32 autodiff/adjoint vs centered float64 FD, step 1e-5
tolerances.dam_order: >=0.45, shock and rarefaction numerical diffusion yield sub-first-order L1 convergence
tolerances.mass: 1e-5 relative to initial total, float32 conservation

deep_cases.initial: benchmark sinusoid plus uniform noise; linear eta or nonlinear total depth and identical q; inputs quantized to float32
deep_cases.tolerance: 1e-4 max error divided by peak reference surface perturbation or discharge; verified with float32 perturbation evolution, with output depth rounded once
deep_cases.cross_path_tolerance: 2e-4 of peak reference surface perturbation or discharge, triangle bound for two independently rounded float32 results
deep_cases.method: avoid hydrostatic pressure cancellation and repeated rounding of total depth, e.g. evolve eta=h-H and subtract constant g*H^2/2 from momentum flux
